name: Platform security progress
description:
> 🤖 Generated by the Agentic Engineer

Managed by platform GitOps: coroot-security-progress/v1.
Start with collection quality and coverage, then track remaining policy outcomes, observed posture failures and full-image vulnerability occurrences. Trend charts show net change, never individual closures. Scan freshness is unknown and runtime delivery is unproven, so no universal green badge is claimed. Keep PolicyReporter until observed result parity and drill-down usability are proven. Delivery and acceptance: https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/5260 . Related coverage and runtime follow-ups: https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/2447 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/3156 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/4263 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/4264 . Inspect current reports for complete finding messages.

groups.name: Overview: remaining work and evidence quality

panels.name: Collection success by surface
panels.description: 1 means the latest attempt collected successfully; 0 means collection failed. A missing line is unknown. Collection success does not prove security posture or runtime alert delivery.

queries.query: min by (surface) (platform_security_collection_success)

panels.name: Collection age in seconds
panels.description: A line at or above 900 seconds (15 minutes) is stale. This clock records metric collection, not Kubescape scan completion. Missing clocks are unknown.

queries.query: time() - min by (surface) (platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)

panels.name: Remaining policy outcomes
panels.description: Failed, warning and error rule-resource outcomes in the current PolicyReports. These are not unique resources. PolicyReporter remains the detail view until observed parity is complete. Data gaps are unknown: counts are shown only when the surface collected successfully within 15 minutes. The snapshot timestamp records collection time, not scan completion. Zero is meaningful only inside the stated observed scope.

queries.query: (sum(platform_security_policy_total{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Observed failed posture outcomes
panels.description: Failed control-resource outcomes in reports mapped to live identities. Coverage below exposes missing, stale or unusable reports. Stored reports do not reveal scan age; this is not a complete platform health score. Data gaps are unknown: counts are shown only when the surface collected successfully within 15 minutes. The snapshot timestamp records collection time, not scan completion. Zero is meaningful only inside the stated observed scope.

queries.query: (sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Observed posture pass share (%)
panels.description: Passed / (passed + failed), using observed pass/fail control-workload pairs only. Accepted and skipped outcomes are excluded; they are not fixes. Incomplete coverage and unknown scan age prevent whole-platform compliance claims. An empty denominator or unsuccessful/stale collection yields no usable percentage.

queries.query: (100 * sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="passed"}) / sum(platform_security_posture_total{status=~"passed|failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))
queries.legend: Observed pass/fail control-workload pairs: pass share (%)

panels.name: Posture coverage and denominator
panels.description: Expected live identities versus current report coverage. Missing, orphan, stale, split, failing, partial, empty and pending are collection or coverage gaps, never closed findings. A complete collection does not establish scan freshness.

queries.query: (sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="posture"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Vulnerability coverage and denominator
panels.description: Expected live images versus current stored summary coverage. Full-image totals count image-CVE occurrences; the same CVE on several images counts several times. No relevance-filtered metric is implied.

queries.query: (sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="vulnerability"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Assurance limits: 0 means unproven
panels.description: Posture freshness observable=0 means stored reports lack a scan timestamp. Runtime delivery verified=0 means the agent-to-rule-to-alert path has not been proven. A quiet runtime stream is not a green security result.

queries.query: (min(platform_security_posture_freshness_observable)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

(min(platform_security_runtime_delivery_verified)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

groups.name: Remaining issues: choose the next remediation

panels.name: Policy findings by severity
panels.description: Prioritize the remaining fail, warn and error rule-resource outcomes. Empty detail buckets are absent rather than silently replaced with zero. The total above is the authoritative zero-capable count.

queries.query: (sum by (severity, status) (platform_security_policy_results{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Observed posture failures by severity
panels.description: Prioritize observed failed control-resource outcomes. Accepted and skipped raw results appear separately in the Kubescape dashboard, and do not count as fixes.

queries.query: (sum by (severity) (platform_security_posture_results{status="failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Full-image vulnerability occurrences
panels.description: Current live-image summary totals by severity. These are image-CVE occurrences, not unique CVEs, affected workloads, exploitable findings or verified fixes.

queries.query: (sum by (severity) (platform_security_vulnerabilities{context="full"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Runtime coverage still needs delivery proof
panels.description: Coverage can expose missing profiles or agent/rule gaps, but cannot establish alert delivery. Track the separate verified=0 limit above until the linked runtime acceptance work is proven.

queries.query: (sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="runtime"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

name: Kyverno remaining policy findings
description:
> 🤖 Generated by the Agentic Engineer

Managed by platform GitOps: coroot-security-progress/v1.
Track remaining fail, warn and error rule-resource outcomes; separate skips; identify the policy, rule and resource to remediate. Downward gauge movement is net reduction and can include scope or resource changes. Coroot v1.22.2 provides time-series charts, so legends supply resource identities while PolicyReporter and PolicyReports retain complete messages and report inspection. Keep PolicyReporter until observed parity and usable drill-down are demonstrated. Acceptance: https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/5260 .

groups.name: Overview: residual outcomes before pass share

panels.name: Remaining policy outcomes
panels.description: Track remaining failed, warning and error rule-resource outcomes downward. A single resource can fail several rules. Zero is emitted after a valid empty scope; a data gap remains unknown. Data gaps are unknown: counts are shown only when the surface collected successfully within 15 minutes. The snapshot timestamp records collection time, not scan completion. Zero is meaningful only inside the stated observed scope.

queries.query: (sum(platform_security_policy_total{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Pass share of evaluated outcomes (%)
panels.description: Pass / (pass + fail + warn + error). Skips are excluded and shown separately. A pass share of 100% applies to evaluated PolicyReport outcomes only; it is not proof of universal policy coverage or platform health.

queries.query: (100 * sum(platform_security_policy_total{status="pass"}) / sum(platform_security_policy_total{status=~"pass|fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Policy outcomes by raw status
panels.description: Pass, fail, warn, error and skip are raw outcomes. A skip is an excluded result, not a remediated finding. Counts are rule-resource outcomes.

queries.query: (sum by (status) (platform_security_policy_total)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Daily net change in remaining outcomes
panels.description: Current remaining outcomes minus the value one day ago. Negative is net reduction; positive is net growth. Resource deletion, scope changes and new findings also change the gauge, so this does not count individually closed issues. Both observations must have fresh successful collections.

queries.query: ((sum(platform_security_policy_total{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) - (sum(platform_security_policy_total{status=~"fail|warn|error"} offset 1d))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"} offset 1d) == 1) and on() (time() - 86400 - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"} offset 1d) >= 0) and on() (time() - 86400 - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"} offset 1d) < 900))

groups.name: Remaining findings: policy, rule and resource

panels.name: Largest remaining policy and rule groups
panels.description: Up to 30 policy/rule/status groups, ordered by remaining outcome count. Use this to choose the next remediation group. PolicyReporter retains complete policy messages and report history.

queries.query: (topk(30, sum by (source, policy, rule, status, severity) (platform_security_policy_results{status=~"fail|warn|error"}))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Remaining outcomes by namespace
panels.description: Rule-resource outcomes grouped by namespace and status. Cluster-scoped findings have the source namespace label. This is a work queue, not an inferred workload or ownership count.

queries.query: (sum by (namespace, status) (platform_security_policy_results{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Resource drill-down: remaining rule failures
panels.description: Up to 50 current findings. Hover over the legend to identify policy, rule and resource; then open its PolicyReport or PolicyReporter for the full result message and remediation context. This chart is a bounded sample, not a full findings table.

queries.query: (topk(50, platform_security_policy_finding{status=~"fail|warn|error"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

panels.name: Raw skipped outcomes: excluded from pass share
panels.description: Skipped rule-resource results remain visible and do not count as closed failures. Review skip coverage separately when evaluating whether PolicyReporter can be retired.

queries.query: (sum by (source, policy, rule, namespace) (platform_security_policy_results{status="skip"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="policy"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="policy"}) < 900))

name: Kubescape remediation progress
description:
> 🤖 Generated by the Agentic Engineer

Managed by platform GitOps: coroot-security-progress/v1.
Track observed live-identity posture failures and current live-image vulnerability summary totals alongside expected coverage. Vulnerabilities are full-image image-CVE occurrences; relevance and accepted findings are not claimed as fixes. Stored posture has no trustworthy scan timestamp, and runtime alert delivery remains unproven. No universal green platform score is inferred. Hover over chart legend labels for control/resource/image identity and inspect current report details. Acceptance: https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/5260 . Coverage/runtime follow-ups: https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/2447 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/3156 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/4263 , https://github.com/devantler-tech/platform/issues/4264 .

groups.name: Overview: observed outcomes and coverage gaps

panels.name: Observed failed posture outcomes
panels.description: Failed control-resource outcomes mapped to live identities. A low number cannot clear missing or stale coverage, unknown scan age, accepted results or unproven runtime delivery. Data gaps are unknown: counts are shown only when the surface collected successfully within 15 minutes. The snapshot timestamp records collection time, not scan completion. Zero is meaningful only inside the stated observed scope.

queries.query: (sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Full-image vulnerability occurrences by severity
panels.description: Current live-image vulnerability summary totals; each image-CVE occurrence counts once per image. These are full-image totals, including results that may be irrelevant or accepted. No exploitability or verified-fix claim is made.

queries.query: (sum by (severity) (platform_security_vulnerabilities{context="full"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Observed posture pass share (%)
panels.description: Passed / (passed + failed), using observed pass/fail control-workload pairs only. Accepted and skipped outcomes are excluded; they are not fixes. Incomplete coverage and unknown scan age prevent whole-platform compliance claims. An empty denominator or unsuccessful/stale collection yields no usable percentage.

queries.query: (100 * sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="passed"}) / sum(platform_security_posture_total{status=~"passed|failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))
queries.legend: Observed pass/fail control-workload pairs: pass share (%)

panels.name: Posture coverage and expected live identities
panels.description: Expected and current must be read together. Missing, orphan, stale, split, failing, partial, pending and empty reports are visible gaps. Reports mapped to deleted resources are excluded from current finding totals.

queries.query: (sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="posture"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Vulnerability coverage and expected live images
panels.description: A low vulnerability count is meaningful only alongside expected live-image coverage. Missing, stale, split, partial, empty or failing summaries are not interpreted as clean images.

queries.query: (sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="vulnerability"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Posture scan age remains unknown
panels.description: This source provides no trustworthy scan completion timestamp. The observable line is 0 until that source capability exists; a freshly collected stored report may still describe an old scan. No universal green posture score is emitted.

queries.query: (min(platform_security_posture_freshness_observable)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Runtime delivery remains unproven
panels.description: Runtime delivery verified stays 0 until agent, profile/rule and alert-delivery acceptance evidence is collected. Quiet events and complete inventories do not substitute for an exercised delivery path.

queries.query: (min(platform_security_runtime_delivery_verified)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

(sum by (state) (platform_security_coverage{surface="runtime"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

groups.name: Remaining issues: controls, resources and images

panels.name: Failed controls to remediate next
panels.description: Up to 30 controls grouped by severity and failed control-resource outcome count. Raw operator results do not automatically apply the platform's CI or Headlamp exceptions.

queries.query: (topk(30, sum by (control, severity) (platform_security_posture_results{status="failed"}))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Resource drill-down: observed failed controls
panels.description: Up to 50 failed control-resource outcomes. Hover over the legend for the control and resource identity, then inspect its current workload configuration report and remediation guidance. This is a sample, not a complete findings table.

queries.query: (topk(50, platform_security_posture_finding{status="failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Images with the largest full-image vulnerability counts
panels.description: Up to 30 image/severity groups. The legend supplies the image for report inspection. Counts reflect current stored full-image summaries and do not deduplicate a CVE across different images.

queries.query: (topk(30, sum by (image, severity) (platform_security_vulnerability_image{context="full"}))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Daily net change in observed failed posture outcomes
panels.description: Current observed failures minus one day ago, using successful recent collections on both observations. Negative is net reduction; report coverage, resource lifecycle, exceptions and new findings can also change this number. It is not a count of individually closed issues.

queries.query: ((sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="failed"})) - (sum(platform_security_posture_total{status="failed"} offset 1d))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900)) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"} offset 1d) == 1) and on() (time() - 86400 - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"} offset 1d) >= 0) and on() (time() - 86400 - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"} offset 1d) < 900))

groups.name: Accepted, skipped and unknown results remain separate

panels.name: Raw accepted, skipped and unknown posture outcomes
panels.description: These outcomes stay separate from observed failures. Accepted is derived only from explicit exception evidence in the source result; raw acceptance is not proof that an underlying weakness was fixed. Skips and unknown results do not count as remediations.

queries.query: (sum by (status) (platform_security_posture_total{status!~"passed|failed"})) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))

panels.name: Controls behind excluded or unknown outcomes
panels.description: Up to 30 control/status groups outside passed and failed. Investigate the report's reason before treating an exception, skip or unknown as an intentional decision. Source results may not incorporate the platform's exception surfaces.

queries.query: (topk(30, sum by (control, severity, status) (platform_security_posture_results{status!~"passed|failed"}))) and on() ((min(platform_security_collection_success{surface="kubescape"}) == 1) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) >= 0) and on() (time() - min(platform_security_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{surface="kubescape"}) < 900))
